intro: If you want a Phayao stay that's not a shophouse in the middle of town but a quiet garden house where you open your door to greenery, a stream and a mock waterfall on a budget of just a few hundred baht — DD Garden Home is a name slow-travel visitors to Phayao bring up often · a small resort-style garden guesthouse in the Ban Tam area on the Ing River, just about a 15 min drive from Kwan Phayao · the rooms are roomy at 28–36 sqm with garden-view balconies, and the owner speaks English and is warm and hands-on · rooms start at about THB 900/night, and it's ranked #2 of 16 specialty stays in Mueang Phayao on Tripadvisor (4.7 out of 5)

body.html: The overview and who it suits — the shortest possible summary is that DD Garden Home is a small resort-style garden guesthouse selling quiet privacy and a green, shady setting at a price that's very reachable for a few hundred to low-thousand baht budget · it isn't a town hotel within walking distance of restaurants, and it isn't a luxury lakeside resort with an infinity pool — it's a garden house where the owner has deliberately planted trees and built a stream and mock waterfall around the property until that became its main charm · the people it suits best, going by real reviews, are couples wanting to escape the bustle, small families driving in on their own, and nature travellers who'd rather wake up to the sound of water and birds than traffic · another group that says it was impressed is remote workers (workation) who want a big room, a work desk, working Wi-Fi and a quiet garden corner to sit and rest · on the flip side, if you're a night-out type who wants to walk straight out to restaurants and cafes, or you don't have your own car, this may not be the most convenient choice, since it's outside the walkable area and you'll need a car to get into town or out to Kwan Phayao · call it a stay that suits people who value "peace and a pretty garden" over "being easy to walk around," and that's the thing to weigh up before you book

Location and getting around — DD Garden Home sits at 229 Moo 13 Ban Tha Ruea, Phahonyothin Road, Ban Tam Subdistrict, Mueang Phayao District, a suburban area to the north of Phayao town, right by Phahonyothin Road and not far from the Ing River that flows down into Kwan Phayao · the thing to understand first is that this location is a relaxed rural riverside setting with fields, gardens and scattered houses — not the town centre with shops within walking distance · from the stay, getting into Phayao town and Kwan Phayao takes about 12–15 min by car, and Wat Sri Khom Kham (Phra Chao Ton Luang), the King Ngam Mueang Monument and the lakeside walking street are all a similar distance · Wat Analyo Thipayaram on Doi Busarakham, the highlight for high-up lake views, is about a 25–30 min drive away · because it's right on Phahonyothin Road, driving on toward Chiang Rai, Chiang Kham or back down toward Lampang is easy, making it a handy stopover on a northern Thailand road trip · the key thing to note is the car situation — nearly every review stresses that you "should have your own car" here, because it's outside town, public transport is limited and hailing a ride isn't as easy as in a big city · there's free parking on the spacious grounds, so driving in yourself is the most comfortable option

"Such a pretty garden house, lots of trees, with a mock waterfall and stream you can stroll around, big clean rooms, a kind owner who speaks English, lovely price, super quiet. Really good for a getaway — but you do need a car, it's a little way out of town."

Room types and decor — even though it's a small guesthouse, the thing that earns DD Garden Home plenty of praise is that the rooms are bigger than you'd expect for the price — roughly 28–36 sqm, which is bigger than the standard rooms at many hotels in Phayao town · there are several types to choose from by group size, from the Standard Twin (2 single beds) for friends or two people, up to the Deluxe King Bed (1 large bed), Deluxe Twin (1 single + 1 large bed) and Deluxe 3 Single Beds that takes three people, just right for a small group or family · every room has air conditioning, satellite TV, a kettle, a work desk, a private bathroom with a shower and free toiletries, and a seating area · what a lot of people like is the private balcony looking out onto the green garden — open the door, sit out and sip a coffee in the cool air · the decor is a clean, simple modern style in warm tones, looking new and earning praise for quality construction · most reviews agree the rooms are very clean, spacious and good value · the honest thing to note, mentioned repeatedly, is that the mattresses are fairly firm — some reviews say outright they were "firmer than expected," so if you like a soft, fluffy mattress, prepare yourself or ask the stay ahead of time, you can request an extra pillow or topper

Facilities, the garden and the atmosphere — the heart of this place isn't a pool or a gym, it's the garden the owner deliberately landscaped, with all kinds of trees, a stream and a mock waterfall flowing so you can hear the gentle sound of water, making the whole property shady like a little garden resort · many reviews call this garden the number-one standout, because you can stroll and take photos in it and it builds a quiet atmosphere you won't get from a town hotel · besides the garden there's also an on-site cafe/sitting-and-drinking corner, spacious free parking, free Wi-Fi and bicycle rental to ride around or out toward the riverside · there's daily cleaning and a laundry service · the common areas are non-smoking · to be honest, this place has no swimming pool or big-resort facilities, so if your trip is planned around soaking in a pool every day, it may not be the right pick — but if the goal is a quiet garden atmosphere and privacy, it pulls that off beyond its price · another thing to know is that some reviews mention construction noise from neighbouring land at times, which is something that changes over time, so ask about the current situation before booking if you're especially sensitive to noise

Food and the cafe — DD Garden Home has fresh-made breakfast that earns praise for being tasty and made with care; many reviews say it's a homemade-style breakfast cooked by the owner or the team, not an industrial buffet, so it feels warm, like staying at a relative's house · there's an outdoor seating corner in the garden and an on-site cafe for a coffee in the morning or afternoon among the trees and the sound of the mock waterfall · for other meals, since the stay is outside town, the restaurant options within walking distance aren't as plentiful as in the town centre · so most people drive into Phayao town or out to the lakeside to find lunch and dinner, where there are local restaurants, lake-fish spots and riverside places to choose from · anyone driving along Phahonyothin Road will also come across roadside eateries and coffee shops along the way · in short, on food the strength here is the "fresh-made breakfast" and the atmosphere of eating in the garden, while other meals rely on heading out — which fits the style of using this as a relaxing base and then driving out to eat and explore around Kwan Phayao

Service and the owner — this is another point praised most strongly in real reviews · the owner earns praise for being warm, good-natured and able to speak English, which makes international guests feel at ease and well looked after · many reviews tell of the owner happily recommending things to see and eat and driving routes around Phayao, with some even saying it felt like having a Phayao friend looking out for them throughout the trip · extras like daily cleaning, laundry, bicycle rental and small concierge touches are done well for a family-run guesthouse · being a small place the owner runs personally gives the service a high level of personal attention, a charm big chain hotels can't match · the trade-off is that, because it's a small place run hands-on, the response to some things may not always be as quick as a hotel with 24-hour staff, especially outside check-in hours (check-in 2:00 PM–8:00 PM), so if you'll arrive late you should let them know in advance

Voices from real reviews (both praise and gripes) — gathering from Tripadvisor, Trip.com, Agoda and Booking.com, the picture is fairly consistent and leans positive · clearest of all is that on Tripadvisor it ranks #2 of 16 specialty stays in Mueang Phayao, with a score of about 4.7 out of 5, with cleanliness, service and value scoring full or nearly full marks · on the praise side: a pretty garden with a shady mock waterfall and stream, big clean rooms that look new, quality construction, a friendly owner who speaks English, tasty fresh-made breakfast, quiet privacy and great value · on the note side: the most-mentioned thing is the fairly firm mattresses (some reviews use the words firmer than expected), the location being outside town so you need your own car with walking being inconvenient, and a few voices mentioning construction noise from neighbouring land at certain times · overall the gripes are things you can manage by preparing properly, rather than big problems that put people off coming back, and the very-good average score reflects that most guests are happy

"Far better value than the price. Big room, beautifully decorated and modern, the owner is so kind and recommended places to visit the whole time, the fresh-made breakfast is delicious · the only gripe is the mattress was a touch too firm for us, next time we'll ask for an extra topper."

Price comparison and value — room rates at DD Garden Home start at about THB 900/night for a standard room in the normal price range, and the bigger Deluxe rooms or ones that take three people move up to around THB 1,100–1,500/night depending on size and season · compared with stays of the same level in Phayao town — many town hotels are similarly priced but give you a smaller room and no garden, while lakeside resorts with a pool cost quite a bit more · so DD Garden Home sits at a point that's great value for people who value a big room, a pretty garden and quiet over needing a pool or a walkable location near restaurants · counting in the fresh-made breakfast, free parking, bikes to borrow and the owner's warm care, the overall feeling is "paying little but getting an atmosphere beyond your money," which is why the value score in real reviews is especially high · the tip is to compare rates across several platforms before booking, because for a small place like this the prices on Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com differ slightly at certain times, and sometimes booking direct with the stay gets a good rate too

Things to know before booking — several things help make the stay smoother · one, you should have your own car, because the stay is in the Ban Tam area outside town, public transport isn't convenient, and there's spacious free parking to take you · two, prepare yourself for the fairly firm mattress — if you like a soft mattress, try asking for a topper or extra pillow in advance · three, check-in is between 2:00 PM and 8:00 PM and check-out is before noon, so if you'll arrive late or very late in the evening, let the stay know ahead of time, since it's a small place run hands-on with no 24-hour counter · four, if you're especially sensitive to noise, try asking about the neighbouring construction situation for the time you'll be staying · five, plan to drive into town or out to the Kwan Phayao lakeside for lunch and dinner, because restaurants within walking distance of the stay are limited · six, make the most of the garden and the bikes — getting up early to stroll the garden or cycle in the cool air is when the atmosphere here is at its prettiest

The verdict — from all the real reviews, DD Garden Home Phayao is one of Mueang Phayao's best-value garden guesthouses for people who want a quiet getaway in a green setting by the Ing River · the strengths are clear — big clean rooms that look new, a shady mock waterfall garden, fresh-made breakfast, a friendly owner who speaks English, and a price that's very light for what you get · so it's no surprise it ranks #2 of 16 specialty stays in Mueang Phayao on Tripadvisor · but it has to be admitted honestly that this isn't a luxury lakeside resort with a pool, isn't in town within walking distance of restaurants, and the mattresses are fairly firm · if your trip is about easy walking, nightlife or full big-resort facilities, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a stay in town or by the lake instead · but for people driving in on their own and looking for a quiet, private garden house at a lovely price, with an owner who looks after you like a friend — DD Garden Home meets exactly that, and it's the reason many guests say they want to come back

faq.q: Where is DD Garden Home · how do you get there?
faq.a: It's at 229 Moo 13 Ban Tha Ruea, Phahonyothin Road, Ban Tam Subdistrict, Mueang Phayao District, a suburban area by the Ing River · about a 12–15 min drive from Phayao town and Kwan Phayao · close to lakeside sights like Wat Sri Khom Kham and the lakeside walking street · right on Phahonyothin Road, easy to drive on to Chiang Rai/Chiang Kham · there's free parking, suiting people who drive in; those without a car may find it less convenient

faq.q: What's the starting price at DD Garden Home · what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rooms start at about THB 900/night in the normal range · there are several types, from Standard Twin Beds · Deluxe King Bed · Deluxe Twin Beds · up to Deluxe 3 Single Beds for a small group · rooms are roomy at about 28–36 sqm with garden-view balconies · prices depend on the season and holidays, so compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com before booking

faq.q: What are the atmosphere and garden like · is there a pool?
faq.a: The standout is the garden the owner landscaped themselves, with all kinds of trees, a stream and a mock waterfall, shady and quiet like a little resort, where you can stroll and take photos · there's an on-site cafe, bikes to borrow and fresh-made breakfast · there's no swimming pool · it suits people who want a getaway in a quiet garden setting over big-resort facilities

faq.q: Who is DD Garden Home for?
faq.a: It suits couples, small families and nature travellers who drive in on their own and want a quiet getaway in a garden house · the owner is friendly and speaks English, so it suits international guests too · if you're focused on walking around town to eat, nightlife, or want a pool, a stay in town or a lakeside resort may suit you better

faq.q: What are the review scores like · are there any gripes?
